# PeoplesHR

> Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM) and payroll platform for growing and enterprise organisations.

PeoplesHR helps businesses manage employee information, statutory payroll, time and attendance, leave, employee self-service, talent and performance, people analytics, and workforce compliance from one cloud platform.

## Product modules

- HR Essentials: employee information, organisational structure, document management — /features/hr-essentials
- Payroll & Time: payroll processing, time and attendance, leave management — /features/payroll-time
- People Experience: employee self-service, requests and approvals, mobile access — /features/people-experience
- Talent & Performance: recruitment and onboarding, performance management, learning support — /features/talent-performance
- People Insights: dashboards, workforce analytics, custom reports — /features/people-insights
- Compliance & Workforce: regulatory compliance, policy management, multi-country support — /features/compliance-workforce

## Packages

- Foundation: essential HR operations for smaller teams (core HR, payroll, leave, attendance, ESS)
- Growth: complete HR solution for scaling organisations (adds talent, performance, native mobile ESS)
- Enterprise: advanced multi-country payroll, analytics, compliance controls, APIs, and SSO

Details: /packages

## Market notes

- Statutory payroll cues referenced in product content include EPF, ETF, and PAYE/APIT
- Currency cues include LKR alongside other multi-currency support on higher tiers
